parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin protective coating. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and graphical user interfaces. It serves as the primary output component for visual information.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though it may tilt slightly depending on the mounting design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It connects the screen to the surface it rests on.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, ensuring it remains upright and stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base is typically stationary, though it may allow limited tilt or swivel movement depending on the design.
